description: This file defines the interface IController for an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) system using protobuf RPC. It extends google::protobuf::RpcController and provides methods for managing RPC calls, including client identification, failure handling, and cancellation. The interface is intended for use in a server-client architecture within the Rialto IPC framework.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface extending google::protobuf::RpcController, providing additional methods for managing RPC calls, retrieving client info, and handling failures within the Rialto IPC framework.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the RPC controller to its initial state, allowing reuse for a new call.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Checks if the previous RPC call failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the error from the last failed RPC call.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Initiates cancellation of the ongoing RPC call.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the client that made the RPC call.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Marks the RPC as failed with a given reason.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC has been canceled.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC is canceled.
